chain_words.nuance: walking slowly and relaxed, with no particular destination
general movement on foot at a normal pace
moving faster than usual because of time pressure
moving very quickly, often in a sense of urgency or haste
running at full speed over a short distance

explanation: These words all describe moving on foot, from a relaxed stroll to running at full speed.

usage_notes.difference: 'Walk' is a neutral word for moving on foot; 'stroll' suggests a slow, relaxed walk taken for pleasure.
